content.text: This tool provides an auto-updating generation widget for these jobs. Do not call job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids to display these jobs again, either before or after completion, unless the user explicitly requests a separate display. If you need to await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15. Use job_display only if the user explicitly requests a separate re-display of one specific job.

- 10b5918a-ece4-4b78-a108-1ce403f4c017  "Create ONE neutral posture/contact master from the audited identity and any supplied essential prop authority. Six-year-old seated on RIGHT chair behind the SAME round table, body LEFT, neutral relaxed face, hands resting at the near edge, feet supported. One closed dusty-blue book far LEFT, one blank cream paper and one resting pencil. Complete table/chair/child group, medium-wide slightly raised view; no room. Preserve identity, age, dot-shaped eyes (no anime eyes or enlarged irises), face/nose/ears, hair silhouette and colour, skin, costume colours and body proportions. No redesign, mirroring or extra limbs. Establish the specified camera and support arrangement; keep the complete contact group intact. Soft neutral daylight from upper-left; preserve the established local colours. Include a very light soft attached watercolor contact shadow at visible ground supports, with graded alpha fading to full transparency. No detached blob, dark oval, opaque floor or checkerboard. Preserve opaque subject interiors. 4:3, 2K native transparent PNG; no scenery, labels or diagram marks.

CORRECTION E01: Remove every pale or cream floor patch beneath all supports; retain only a very light neutral warm-grey contact shadow with low graded alpha, attached to all soles/legs and fading to zero. Preserve every subject/furniture pixel and camera outside the shadow. The attached single instruction board contains the original identity and furniture authorities, unchanged full geometry target, failure evidence and approved shadow-alpha example. All labels and diagnostics are instruction-only. Preserve all passing features; do not copy the positive example footprint or add a room.
"

If the user requests a combined display of multiple generations, including jobs submitted through separate generate_* calls, collect all requested job IDs, wait for the complete set with jobs_wait, then call show_generation_by_ids with jobs: [{"index":0,"job_id":"<first actual job ID>"},{"index":1,"job_id":"<second actual job ID>"}, ...]. job_display accepts only one id: never pass ids to it or loop over it to show a group. Do not create an extra display when the existing generation widgets already satisfy the request.
